oneLine: Venus Pipes lands $39M share sale led by WhiteOak, Ashoka, and Carnelian.

sources.title: Venus Pipes lands $39M share sale led by WhiteOak, Ashoka, Carnelian

synopsis: Venus Pipes and Tubes has approved a ₹372 crore preferential share issue on a private placement basis, allotting up to 2,227,544 equity shares to 18 non-promoter public investors at ₹1,670 each. Backers include Kitara PIIN 2401 taking ₹50 crore, WhiteOak Capital India Opportunities Fund taking ₹42 crore, Ashoka WhiteOak India Opportunities Fund taking ₹39.63 crore, and individual investor Ashish Kacholia taking ₹30 crore, alongside Carnelian, Tata, and Kotak Mahindra Life Insurance. Inga Ventures advised the raise. The transaction will drop promoter holding from 48.41% to 43.71% and increase public shareholding from 51.59% to 56.29%. The allotment requires shareholder approval at an extraordinary general meeting called for October 8, 2026.
